# Find Your Yellow Tux — Jesse Cole

> Jesse Cole is a keynote speaker, the founder of Fans First Entertainment, the owner of the Savannah Bananas, and the author of Find Your Yellow Tux, Fans First, and Banana Ball. His teams have welcomed more than 1,000,000 fans to their ballparks. He speaks to companies and associations about customer experience, fan engagement, leadership, and standing out.

## Key facts

- Full name: Jesse Cole
- Roles: Keynote speaker, author, founder of Fans First Entertainment, owner of the Savannah Bananas
- Known for: The yellow tuxedo, Banana Ball, and the mantra "If it's normal, do the exact opposite."
- Books: Find Your Yellow Tux (2017), Fans First, Banana Ball
- Based in: Savannah, Georgia, United States
- Speaking formats: In-person keynote (45–75 minutes), virtual keynote, half-day and full-day workshops, event emcee
- Signature keynote: The Fans First Way, built on the 5 E's: eliminate friction, entertain always, experiment constantly, engage deeply, empower action
- Other keynotes: How to Design the Ultimate Customer Experience; If It's Normal, Do the Exact Opposite
- Travel: United States and international; virtual and hybrid available
- Media coverage: People, ESPN, Associated Press, Los Angeles Times, Inc., Fast Company, Entrepreneur
